situation: A web task adds a per-item action button (remove, edit) to a list rendered from state, or renames a visible button label that existing browser tests select by accessible name.
right_direction: Create the button inside the existing render loop with type=button and an aria-label of action word plus item name; mutate the state and call the same render function so totals and empty-state text stay derived; update every getByRole name selector that used the old label in the same commit.
anti_pattern: Patching the row DOM by hand instead of re-rendering (the total and the empty note drift); leaving old-label selectors in existing specs (each times out after 30s and red-lights the suite).
